subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should `question.*`, `operator.questions`, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` be accepted as the permanent public Gateway and plugin contract for provider-neutral human questions?
rationale: This is a broad new cross-client API surface rather than a repair to an established behavior; code review can assess correctness, but only owners can set the long-term protocol and SDK boundary.

options.title: Confirm the public contract
options.body: Accept the documented Gateway scope, RPC/event family, and SDK subpath as the shared provider-neutral question seam.

options.title: Narrow the initial surface
options.body: Keep the feature internal to the embedded agent and Control UI until the external plugin and native-client contract is separately designed.

recommendation.title: Confirm the public contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented Gateway scope, RPC/event family, and SDK subpath as the shared provider-neutral question seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related feature and this follow-up’s supplied history show direct ownership of the question-runtime direction.
